evidenceContext.sourceRevisionProvenance: Recorded source revision supplied by the test coordinator; the initial revision also matches frozen-observations.json metadata.
evidenceContext.browser: Local headless Chromium loaded the static UI; API calls traversed an authenticated Jupyter bridge to the live Decision Lab server on Akamai.
evidenceContext.providerLatency: latencyMs, p50, and p95 are measured by the remote Decision Lab server around actual GPU endpoint requests, including transport and response handling. They are not GPU-only forward-pass timings.
evidenceContext.browserLatency: browserRoundTripMs and totalMs include the authenticated Jupyter bridge and local browser work. They are not measurements of a publicly deployed demo.
evidenceContext.imageTransport: Incorrectly embedded image parts in state; SGLang treated them as text. These image-mode runs did not exercise valid native vision processing and are retained only as failure evidence.
evidenceContext.accuracy: A business decision is correct only when every requested field matches policy. Courier correctness scores shortest-path moves; checkpoint completion is reported separately. No failures or non-optimal moves are removed.
evidenceContext.credentials: No credentials, private URLs, pod addresses, or browser image payloads are included.
